cowbell-open.describe: cowbell, open hit on the mouth

cowbell-mute.describe: cowbell, muted hit on the neck

conga-slap.describe: conga accent. VCSL has no slap, so the hard open quinto stands in

conga-mute.describe: conga muted finger stroke, used for the heel and toe ghost notes

whistle-short.describe: samba whistle, short blast. The stock stand-in is a clave, which is rough

whistle-long.describe: samba whistle, long blast. The stock stand-in is a clave, which is rough

phrases.name: Andalusian cadence
phrases.description: Minor tonic stepping down to a major V. The most recognisable Spanish sound.

phrases.name: Phrygian vamp
phrases.description: Major tonic with the flat second above it. Dark Spanish colour; give the key as the tonic of the major chord, for example E phrygian.

phrases.name: Minor montuno
phrases.description: Tonic, subdominant, dominant, tonic. The plain son and salsa turnaround.

phrases.name: Two-chord montuno
phrases.description: Tonic and dominant only. Leaves room for piano and percussion.

phrases.name: Dorian vamp
phrases.description: Minor seventh to the major IV7. A two-bar vamp for long grooves.

phrases.name: Guajira
phrases.description: Bright major three-chord loop.

phrases.name: Minor house anthem
phrases.description: The lifting minor loop behind a great deal of piano house.

phrases.name: Major house anthem
phrases.description: Major four-chord loop for a hands-up piano section.

phrases.name: Descending minor
phrases.description: Steps down and back up without the major V, so it loops smoothly.

phrases.name: Salsa turnaround
phrases.description: Two-five-one with a dominant VI to turn it round.

phrases.name: Minor circle of fifths
phrases.roman: i iv bVII bIII bVI iim7b5 V7 i
phrases.description: Eight bars falling through the circle of fifths. Suits a slower, sung section.

phrases.name: Montuno, octaves on the fifth
phrases.description: The standard two-hand montuno: octaves answer the inner chord tones off the beat, and the last hit lands early on the next chord. One bar of sixteenths at house tempo; use stretch 2 for salsa.

phrases.name: Montuno, octaves on the root
phrases.description: Same rhythm with the octaves on the root. Heavier, good when there is no bass.

phrases.name: Single-line guajeo
phrases.description: One-note-at-a-time guajeo in sixteenths, as a tres or a light piano would play it.

phrases.name: House stabs 3-3-3-3-2-2
phrases.description: The classic piano house rhythm: four hits three sixteenths apart, then two quick ones.

phrases.name: Offbeat stabs
phrases.description: A chord on every offbeat eighth, between the kicks.

phrases.name: Stabs on the son clave
phrases.description: Chords on the five strokes of the 3-2 son clave.

phrases.name: Tresillo stabs
phrases.description: 3-3-2 twice in the bar, with the last hit on the next chord.

phrases.name: Pushed stabs
phrases.description: Busier stabs with short ghost chords and an early change.

phrases.name: Two-bar house riff
phrases.description: A call bar and an answer bar that leaves a gap, so the riff breathes.

phrases.name: Octave bass with offbeat chords
phrases.description: Left hand plays low octaves on beats 1 and 3, right hand answers with chords. A full piano part on its own.

phrases.name: Held chords
phrases.description: One chord per bar with the root underneath. For intros and breakdowns.

phrases.name: Ballad chords
phrases.description: Chord, softer repeat and a pickup note.

phrases.name: Arpeggio up and down, sixteenths
phrases.description: Climbs an octave and a third and comes back, twice a bar.

phrases.name: Wide arpeggio, eighths
phrases.description: Open left-hand style arpeggio across two octaves.

phrases.name: Alberti figure
phrases.description: Low, high, middle, high. Gentle and steady.

phrases.name: Rolling triplets
phrases.description: Triplet roll, four groups of three a bar.

phrases.name: Fingerstyle pattern
phrases.description: Thumb on a low root with three fingers above, the way a Spanish guitar arpeggio is picked. Works on piano or a plucked sound.

phrases.name: Falling cascade
phrases.description: Falls two octaves and climbs back within the bar.

phrases.name: Seventh climb
phrases.description: Walks up through the seventh and back. On plain triads the seventh becomes the octave.

phrases.name: Ninth shimmer
phrases.description: Adds the ninth for a softer, deeper colour.

phrases.name: Syncopated pluck
phrases.description: Six single notes on the tresillo pattern. Sits well above stabs.

phrases.name: Tumbao bass
phrases.description: Nothing on beat 1. The fifth on the and of 2, then the next chord's root early on beat 4.

phrases.name: Tumbao bass with a downbeat
phrases.description: The tumbao with the root also on beat 1, which is easier to follow over a four-on-the-floor kick.

phrases.name: Offbeat house bass
phrases.description: Root on every offbeat eighth, in the gaps left by the kick.

phrases.name: Octave bounce
phrases.description: Low root on the beat, octave above on the offbeat.

phrases.name: Latin house bass
phrases.description: Syncopated line that follows the tresillo and pushes into the next chord.

phrases.name: Root and fifth, eighths
phrases.description: Steady eighths that dip to the fifth below.

phrases.name: Two-note chant
phrases.description: A short chant shape in scale degrees: three hits on the fifth, then down to the tonic. Follows the key, not the chords.

phrases.name: Horn answer
phrases.description: Silent for half the bar, then a three-note answer. Place it after a lead phrase.

phrases.name: Flute run
phrases.description: A quick scale run up and back, then two landing notes.

phrases.name: Trumpet solo: call and landing
phrases.description: One trumpet. A syncopated call that pushes into the next chord, then a held note and a walk back down. Leaves the last beat empty.

phrases.name: Trumpet solo: climb to a high note
phrases.description: One trumpet. Runs up the chord to a high held fifth, the peak of a solo. Use it once per section.

phrases.name: Trumpet solo: off the beat
phrases.description: One trumpet. Every note sits between the beats, against the clave. Nothing on beat 1 of either bar.

phrases.name: Trumpet solo: scale run
phrases.description: One trumpet. Chord tones joined by quick passing notes from the scale, falling and rising, ending on a held root.

phrases.name: Trumpet solo: long notes
phrases.description: One trumpet. Slow held notes across four bars for an intro, a break or under a vocal.

phrases.name: Trumpet solo: short answer
phrases.description: One trumpet. Half a bar of silence, then a quick answering figure. Put it after a piano or vocal phrase.

phrases.name: Horn stabs on the clave
phrases.description: Short section chords on the five strokes of the 3-2 son clave.

phrases.name: Horn hits
phrases.description: One hit on the downbeat and one pushed hit just before the next bar.

phrases.name: Mambo horn line
phrases.description: A two-bar riff for two trumpets in harmony: a busy call bar, then an answer that lands and rests.

phrases.name: Held horns
phrases.description: Two held notes per bar. Use a sustained trumpet sound, under a build.

phrases.name: House kit, basic
phrases.description: Kick on every beat, clap on 2 and 4, open hat on the offbeats.

phrases.name: House kit with sixteenth hats
phrases.description: Adds a soft closed hat on the sixteenths for drive.

phrases.name: House kit, turnaround bar
phrases.description: One bar to end a phrase: extra kick and a short snare run into the next section.

phrases.name: Kick only
phrases.description: Four on the floor alone, for intros and builds.

phrases.name: Conga tumbao
phrases.description: The basic one-drum tumbao twice in the bar: heel, toe, slap, toe, heel, toe, open, open.

phrases.name: Two-drum tumbao
phrases.description: Two bars. The second bar ends on the low drum, which marks the clave.

phrases.name: House conga loop
phrases.description: Sparser three-drum loop that leaves the beats to the kick.

phrases.name: Bongo martillo
phrases.description: Eight strokes with the low drum on beat 4.

phrases.name: Son clave 3-2
phrases.description: Three strokes then two, in one bar of sixteenths.

phrases.name: Son clave 2-3
phrases.description: The same clave starting on the two side.

phrases.name: Rumba clave 3-2
phrases.description: Son clave with the third stroke moved one sixteenth later.

phrases.name: Campana bell
phrases.description: Open hits on the beats with muted neck strokes between.

phrases.name: Cowbell on the beats
phrases.description: Plain quarter notes, as in a cha-cha.

phrases.name: Cascara
phrases.description: The shell pattern played on the side of the timbales.

phrases.name: Guiro
phrases.description: Long scrape, then two short taps.

phrases.name: Shaker sixteenths
phrases.description: Steady sixteenths with an accent on each beat.

phrases.name: Carnival whistle
phrases.description: Short blasts in a samba pattern with one long blast at the end of the second bar.
